summary: End-to-end validation of new AI Contract Generator module (backend + frontend). All 16 backend contract pytest cases pass (schema, generate w/ real LLM, save+versioning, invalid status 422, restore creates new non-destructive version, PDF/DOCX exports, export-before-save 404, activity logging, proposal_id link/smart data). Full UI flow verified on Brand Redesign project: Contract tab is between Proposal and AI Chat; empty state + generate button render; real LLM generation (~30s) produced all 17 sections; header controls (title input, version, status Select incl. Signed) all present; edit-textareas persist through save (verified via GET history v2); v1 save, v2 save (increment), compare view + exit, restore v1 -> v3, regenerate returns to 'draft'; activity feed shows contract_generated / contract_saved x2 / contract_restored refreshing without reload. Regression: Proposal PDF/DOCX exports still work after exporter generalization (proposal_export.py now takes optional sections+doc_type). Existing proposal/planner/crud tests still pass (2 pre-existing unrelated failures in test_crud unlinking tests + collection error in test_workspace due to missing env var — NOT caused by contract module).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 846 lines — approaching the 700-line guideline; consider splitting contract/proposal/planner routes into modules for maintainability.
test_workspace.py raises KeyError('REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL') at collection time when env var absent — should mirror the fallback used in test_contract.py/test_proposal.py.
seed_data_creation: Tests create/cleanup TEST_CONTRACT_* project/client per module fixture. UI test reused existing 'Brand Redesign' project (5b3538af-0c6a-480e-8b11-c730368e1402) — left contract at v3 with 2 saved versions + 1 restored + regenerated draft (not saved). Cleanup optional.
context_for_next_testing_agent: New AI Contract module fully working. Backend endpoints under /api/projects/{id}/contract[/generate|/versions|/restore/{v}|/export/pdf|/export/docx] and /api/contract/sections. Frontend at ContractWriter.jsx with tab-trigger-contract in ProjectWorkspace. Version bump path: 'draft' -> save=1 -> edit+save=2 -> restore v1 = new v3 (non-destructive). tab-contract testid only appears when contract has content; empty state uses contract-empty testid.
